key_insight: Embedding design is a major driver of QPINN performance, with trainable or adaptive embeddings improving how quantum circuits represent PDE solutions.
engineering_relevance: For quantum machine learning practitioners, the result suggests that better coordinate-to-state embeddings can yield lower error and better optimization without simply increasing circuit size.
method: Unified embedding framework treating embedding as a feature transformation before the variational circuit
LQNN-TE-QPINN: auxiliary quantum circuit generates data-dependent features that are added to coordinates
AdaFreq-QPINN: makes arccos-Chebyshev frequency scales trainable
evidence_signal: On 1D Burgers’ equation, LQNN-TE-QPINN reached relative $L_2$ error 0.0916 with 720 parameters, while AdaFreq-QPINN gave the best results among analytical embeddings; in 2D, LQNN-TE-QPINN achieved the lowest training objective.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on the embedding and may be less clear under hardware noise or in solution error comparisons against strong hybrid baselines.
paper_title: On Embedding Design in Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks
